evidence_checked: field-by-field diff of the genuine claim against the planted control (only six first_end.date values differ)
reasoning: The genuine claim differs from the planted control only in the six first_end.date values (sec2, sec2-b, sec2-c, sec3, sec3-b, sec3-c), which now read 2005-06-17. That is the date of EO 13380, which the held text gives as 'Executive Order 13380 of June 17, 2005'. EO 13380 has no separate effective date, and 2005-06-17 matches the claim's own judgment_reason, later_events and rationale. All other fields are byte-identical to the version reviewed blind. In that review the cited hashes and quoted spans matched, identity and the 18-clause inventory agreed with the held 59 FR 25779 text, the EO 13380 amendments (a)-(e) were described correctly, and EO 14354 continues the Good Neighbor Environmental Board until 2027-09-30. The cruden number search found only EO 13380 and the continuation orders, with no revocation or supersession. On the USMCA question noted in the blind review, the held U.S. Code release point 119-121 note (jobs/current-law/output/usc-notes/idb9a2cace-ac5f-11f1-86f8-df17c10eb1e1.txt) prints the order as amended by EO 13380. It gives current classifications for section 543 at 22 U.S.C. 290m-2, which is consistent with those delegated functions still being in force. The claim treats that note as a lead, and sections 1 and 10 support YES on their own. All three whole-order ends are null, as a YES claim requires.
